# Core: Group (Resource)

A local DSM group. Add users to it with `synology_core_user`'s `groups`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "synology_core_group" "backup_writers" {
  name        = "backup-writers"
  description = "Machines that write backups to the NAS"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The group name. Changing it renames the group in place.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The group name (same as `name`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import an existing group by name.
terraform import synology_core_group.backup_writers backup-writers
```
